in_latin.name: Tiago
in_latin.meaning: Felix, Fortis, Victoriæ victor, Fortis, Felix, Fortis
in_latin.long_meaning: Felix, Fortis, Victoriæ victor, Fortis, Felix, Fortis. A fortis significat fortitudo et victoria. Felix significat felicitas et prosperitatis. Origine Hebraicus, Tiago a fortis et felicitas. In historia Ecclesiae, Tiago significat victoriam et fortitudo in Deo.
